content.stem: 以下哪些情形需要加强尽职调查(EDD)？(选择三项.)

options.A: 一名当地联赛的现役足球运动员试图在当地司法管辖区的一家银行开设银行账户
options.B: 某国现任总理试图在另一国开设银行账户
options.C: 25年前在低风险国家交通部长手下担任过私人秘书的人在邻国的一家低风险国家银行开设银行账户
options.D: 一家位于高风险国家的银行试图与一家位于低风险国家的银行建立代理行/被代理行关系
options.E: 一位在本国拥有现有银行账户的个人成为另一个国家的大使

content.stem_en: Which of the following scenarios warrant enhanced due diligence (EDD)? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: An existing local league footballer trying to open a bank account with a bank in their local jurisdiction.
options_en.B: The current prime minister of a country trying to open a bank account in another country.
options_en.C: The former personal secretary to the minister of transport in a low-risk country 25 years ago opening a bank account at a bank in a neighboring low-risk country.
options_en.D: A bank located in a higher-risk country trying to establish a correspondent-respondent banking relationship with a bank in a lower-risk country.
options_en.E: An individual with a current bank account in their home country who becomes an ambassador to another country.
